notes: CardDemo's update-user screen (CU02, COUSR02C) on GENERATED data and a GENERATED map input (#4506): 20 USRSEC records built from CSUSR01Y's layout, and 30 scenarios whose COMMAREA carries a selected user (a fifth of the time one the file does not hold) and whose RECEIVE MAP input is typed from COUSR02's BMS source (user id drawn from the file with misses, then first name, last name, password and user type by length and class, a tenth not text, three in ten left empty); the key pressed turns through ENTER, PF3, PF4, PF5, PF12 and one the screen does not assign. Each scenario's USRSEC file is compared after the task, so a PF5 update is proven on the file. Proves the carddemo-userupd port on inputs it was not written against; the hand-written scenarios are the COMMAREA-less run and fault runs.
